headline: Review of FY27 budget, salary schedules, maintenance schedule, and candidate interviews for Assistant Executive Director, plus approval of a ramp construction quote for 7-8 Arthur St.
summary: The meeting covers review and approval of the FY27 budget, salary schedules, extraordinary maintenance schedule, flat rent schedule, and payment standards for Section 8. It also includes interviews for Assistant Executive Director candidates, a design work order for the Riverdale Furnace Replacement -Phase 3, and a quote for ramp construction at 7-8 Arthur St.
